title: The Power of Micro-Influencers: Marketing's New Frontier

facts.fact: The page characterizes micro-influencers as having follower counts between 10,000 and 100,000.
facts.quote: Micro-influencers, characterized by smaller follower counts between 10,000 and 100,000, challenge the notion that bigger is always better in marketing.

facts.fact: A Stackla survey, as cited by the page, found that 79% of consumers acknowledge the high impact of user-generated content (UGC) on their purchasing decisions.
facts.quote: reveals that 79% of consumers acknowledge the high impact of UGC on their purchasing decisions.

facts.fact: According to HubSpot, as cited by the page, small-scale influencers generate up to 60% more engagement than their more prominent counterparts.
facts.quote: small-scale influencers, with their niche appeal, generate up to 60% more engagement than their more prominent counterparts.

facts.fact: The Forbes Agency Council article was published on November 21, 2024.
